messages:
anne: :rotating_light: pager fired — high severity: model-quality-regression on /v1/chat/generate. Several customer reports of hallucinations and truncated responses. Observed spike in eval-failure rate ~09:12 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-42. Paging oncall anne. Playbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/model-regression
anne: I can see error rate and quality scores trending down for model: redwood-chat-v2-quant. Canary started ~09:05, full rollout at ~09:09 per deploy-bot. Suspect bad canary -> rollout. @mike can you confirm rollout history?
deploy-bot: rollout log: canary redwood-chat-v2-quant -> success(5%), deploy(100%) triggered by release pipeline #442 at 09:08 UTC. Previous stable model: redwood-chat-v2-ptx.
mike: confirming — full push happened automatically after canary success. I'm pulling logs now. Any customer blocking? @lee pls flag any high-priority customers.
lee: CS reports two paying customers saw hallucination leading to minor data leakage in tool outputs. They're paused and asking for ETA. I'm prepping a careful notification.
ravi: attaching quick eval diffs: new model shows +12% hallucination on prompts set A and +8% on production sampling. Rolling back to previous weights looks safest. Suggest immediate pin to redwood-chat-v2-ptx and rollback.
anne: Agreed. Plan: 1) Pause traffic to redwood-chat-v2-quant 2) Pin /v1/chat/generate to redwood-chat-v2-ptx 3) Run smoke tests 4) Publish statuspage + customer notification 5) Kick off postmortem. Who will execute pins/rollback?
mike: I can do rollback now. Executing command:
```
# rollback traffic rule
redwoodctl routes update /v1/chat/generate --model redwood-chat-v2-ptx --pin --reason "hotfix: regression"
```
I'll run smoke tests afterwards.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued. Job id: rb-7842. Estimated completion: 09:28 UTC.
anne: I'll draft statuspage and customer note. Short status first: "We detected a model quality regression after an automated rollout of redwood-chat-v2-quant. Traffic has been reverted to the prior model and we're validating. No data exfiltration expected. Root cause investigation ongoing."
zoe: Draft for customers (sensitive): "Hi — we observed a regression in model outputs after a recent rollout. We reverted traffic to the previous version and are validating results. Our investigation is ongoing; we'll update within 2 hours. If you see any problematic outputs, reply to this thread and CS will escalate."
lee: Sending to affected customers now (templated, with opt-out for logs). Adding a note that we can rotate any API keys if requested.
incident-bot: Rollback job rb-7842 completed at 09:27 UTC. Route pins updated.
mike: Rollback confirmed. Running quick smoke: sample prompts returning expected outputs. Latency and throughput stable.
ravi: Re-running eval harness against production prompt set. Initial pass looks within acceptable thresholds. Will post detailed diffs in ~20m.
anne: Handoff: I've been oncall 09:00–09:30. @mike, taking over the incident. I'm going to update the incident channel and fill the rotation with context.
mike: Taking oncall. Notes: rollback done, customers notified, monitoring in stabilize phase. I will coordinate postmortem.
anne: FYI drafted statuspage update: "Identified and mitigated model quality regression, traffic reverted to previous model, validation in progress. Customers with impacts notified. Followup investigation in progress." Approving to publish?
zoe: publish now. Also recommend a short CS banner for enterprise customers summarizing remediation and offer dedicated syncs.
lee: Sent to affected customers and posted customer portal message for accounts with anomalies. No urgent escalations so far.
mike: Running ticket to pin model versions in the model registry to avoid auto-rollouts until root cause found. Command: 
```
model-registry lock redwood-chat-v2-quant --state frozen --reason "investigation: regression"
```
ravi: For root cause, initial hypothesis: quantization edge-case in attention kernels for certain prompt shapes. I'll revert the quantization patch and re-run unit tests in staging.
anne: Good. Added follow-ups: postmortem owner @ravi, timeline, detection, rollback steps, communication log. Link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-20260315-42/postmortem
mike: Creating a short retro: update rollout automation to require 15-minute observed canary window for generation-quality metrics, not just latency/throughput. Opening RFC ticket.
zoe: Also recommend cross-team alerting for model-quality regressions to trigger an automatic canary pause before promoting to 100%.
lee: I'll follow up with customers that requested further context and offer remediation help.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-42 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update scheduled in 1 hour.
mike: Closing notes for now: mitigation complete, customers notified, model pinned, postmortem started. Will update when we have RCA.
anne: thanks team — nice quick handle. :thumbsup:
